gate:wb_industrial.rule: Requires Industrial Module + active wire-v1 power

gate:station_refinery.rule: Requires Oil Refinery near L2 Workbench + fuel

gate:station_fuel_non_canister.rule: stationBurnable(): burns fuel items EXCEPT fuel_can

gate:directed_research_tier_lt_3.rule: permitsDirectedResearch(r): only recipe.tier < 3 eligible for 9-Spares directed research

gate:creator_loot_v1.rule: Enabled only on shipping_fresh / dev_delta_fresh; absent on Veyra

gate:loot_ecology_w06.rule: Enabled only on shipping_fresh / dev_delta_fresh; absent on Veyra

gate:recycler_site.rule: webRecyclerSite() authorizes Foundry Yard on shipping_fresh/dev_delta_fresh and VEYRA_RECYCLER_SITE (po_slag) on isVeyra05Layout (null on legacy static Veyra layouts)

gate:oil_test_fixture.rule: Requires r.oilTestFixture === true with authority test-fixture-v1

gate:poi_keycard.rule: Requires physical keycard (3 charges); absent from Veyra loot tables

gate:poi_power.rule: Requires POI generator + fuel_can (180s runtime); absent from Veyra POIs

gate:veyra_spawner.rule: Veyra ecosystem spawns 9 ordinary + 5 wildlife + 4 side bosses + 6 Primordials (excludes wolf/toad/crawler/beetle/crab)

gate:shipping_spawner.rule: Shipping biome spawner spawns boar/wolf/toad/crawler/beetle/crab + 6 legacy Elders

gate:claim_2_limit.rule: Max 2 claims, radius 25 tiles, >=10 tiles from POIs, 25%/24h upkeep

gate:base_power_wire_v1.rule: Requires orthogonal wire-v1 cable path from fueled base_generator

gate:escrow_cash_only.rule: LOCKED_CANON cash-only escrow; converts rcash -> securedCash

gate:ragnarok_final_72h.rule: Final 72h (hour 264..336): suppresses creature rcash drops & boosts threats 1.6x

gate:run_wipe_336h.rule: 336h maxRunHours wipe clears all run-local inventory/structures/knowledge
